exposure: Type of Caesarean section (emergency vs planned)
Individuals born by planned caesarean section
Gestational age at birth (preterm vs term)
Individuals born by emergency caesarean section
Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
cohort: Individuals born in Norway between 1967 and 2003
finding: Caesarean section was associated with a modestly higher risk of developing multiple sclerosis, particularly in individuals born preterm or via emergency caesarean section.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with a modestly higher risk of developing MS, particularly in individuals born preterm (HR=1.62, 95% CI 1.18 to 2.24) or via emergency caesarean section (HR=1.40, 95% CI 1.07 to 1.83).
